units.source_text: 当时给我的第一感觉，就和突然听到K坦白他的爱情时差不多。

en.t: The first feeling I had then was much like when I suddenly heard K confess his love.

units.source_text: 刚看了他屋内一眼，我的眼睛便犹如玻璃做的假眼一般失去了转动的能力。

en.t: The moment I glanced inside his room, my eyes lost the ability to move, like false eyes made of glass.

units.source_text: 我木呆呆地伫立着，惊悚之感像一阵疾风穿透我的身体，我才意识到，完了，又铸成大错了。

en.t: I stood there in a daze, and only after a feeling of horror had pierced through my body like a gust of wind did I realize that it was over, and that I had made another terrible mistake.

units.source_text: 在这一瞬间，无法挽回的黑色之光，射向了我的未来，

en.t: In that instant, an irretrievable black light shot toward my future,

units.source_text: 可怕地照出了我的整个生涯，我止不住地颤抖起来。

en.t: terribly illuminating my entire life, and I began to tremble uncontrollably.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，我还是未能忘记自己。

en.t: Even so, I still could not forget myself.

units.source_text: 我立刻发现桌上放着一封信，信上果然写着我的名字。

en.t: I immediately noticed a letter lying on the desk, and sure enough, my name was written on it.

units.source_text: 我不顾一切地拆开信封，但信中并没有提及一句我所害怕的事。

en.t: I tore open the envelope recklessly, but the letter did not mention a single thing I had feared.

units.source_text: 我原以为信上一定会写很多谴责我的不堪入耳的话，

en.t: I had expected the letter to be filled with unbearable words condemning me,

units.source_text: 我害怕若是夫人和小姐看到了，不知会怎样蔑视我呢。

en.t: and I was afraid that if Madam and the young lady saw them, they would despise me terribly.

units.source_text: 我大致看了一遍，便松了口气

en.t: After skimming through it, I breathed a sigh of relief

units.source_text: （当然只是自己的脸面保住了，

en.t: (of course, it was only my own face that had been saved,

units.source_text: 但脸面对当时的我来说，是非常重要的）。

en.t: but face was extremely important to me at that time).
